Messages.Author: Camo1000
Messages.Body:
Right, from the wording of the cards I think Mukhtar Bey can use trap.

His card text states that he himself cannot press to continue combat, however the trap card stats that it provides the press itself automatically.

Thoughts?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Mukhtar Bey
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Caitiff
Group: 4
Capacity: 7
Discipline: obf pot FOR PRE QUI
Camarilla Prince of Cairo: Mukhtar cannot use presses to continue combat. If there are five Gehenna cards in play during your untap phase, burn Mukhtar.

Correct; Mukhtar can play Trap. And he will also be able to press to end combat in a combat in which he played Trap.
